jobs.occupation: Admissions & Programme Manager of Venture Support Programmes (m/f/d) (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description: Your responsibilities Your Input You understand the challenges of healthcare venture building and are passionate about supporting early-stage entrepreneurs, innovators and researchers through education, mentoring, and capacity-building programmes. As Admissions & Programme Manager, you will manage participant admissions, support learners throughout the programme lifecycle, and help deliver an outstanding learning experience. In collaboration with cross-functional teams, you will also contribute to the design, implementation, quality assurance, and continuous improvement of our venture support programmes.Responsibilities• Manage the admissions process, assess applicants, and guide entrepreneurs and researchers to the most suitable venture support programmes and opportunities, such as venture-building programmes, bootcamps, Catapult initiatives, and scholarship opportunities.• Lead programme implementation, including call launches, applicant engagement, stakeholder coordination, and project management throughout the programme development cycle.• Support programme growth and operations by coordinating launches, optimizing existing programmes, managing invoices, preparing reports, and ensuring compliance with Horizon Europe funding requirements.• You will also support the exploitation of the existing content in future implementations - based on lessons learned, market and clients' needs.• Collaborate across the portfolio to ensure a smooth progression of participants between programmes, connecting innovators and entrepreneurs with the most relevant next-step opportunities, such as advanced venture support programmes and bootcamps.• Coordinate pitching days and showcase events together with programme managers and the events team.Your skills & knowledge What you bring• Master’s degree or higher in health, science, business or entrepreneurship education studies or equivalent professional experience/qualifications.• High level international project management skills, with a good understanding of the complexities involved in developing and delivering project outcomes; proven ability to engage a wide range of stakeholders.• Good understanding of the start-up journey in healthcare; ability to identify their opportunities for improvement and growth; experience in setting and managing standards of delivery to support the cost-effective and targeted delivery of activities and/or programmes.• Sound knowledge of higher education programmes in Europe.• Excellent presentation, communication and interpersonal skills.• Solution-oriented team player and comfortable working primarily remotely.• Ability to work with an international team in a multidisciplinary context and to multi-task and manage a set of deliverables simultaneously.• Languages: English fluent (spoken, written), other European languages an advantage.• Experience in grant management, particularly European Grants (Erasmus+, Horizon 2020, EIT, Horizon Europe …) is a plus.• Prior experience in entrepreneurship education and training is a plus.• Occasional travel (2–4 times per year) may be required.What we offer• We are a 100% “Remote First” company, hiring in Germany, France, Spain and Poland.• The possibility to join offices in various locations around Europe during business travel.• 30 days of vacation & flexible working hours.• Yearly bonus and our employee recognition programme.• Straight forward internal communication, non-hierarchical structure, and freedom to operate with autonomy.• A large and vibrant network in the healthcare sector, with exposure to high-level and senior rep-resentatives from key players and influencers.• The opportunity to work on critical projects of European interest, contributing to improving the lives of citizens and patients.Application process• EIT Health applies a policy of equal opportunities and accepts applications without discrimination on any grounds.• Applications should consist of a cover letter and a full curriculum vitae.• Please include the following in the cover letter: introduction, your motivations for applying for the position, your earliest start date, and your salary expectations.• Applications via our careers page only.• Applications will be reviewed on the rolling basis until the right candidate is identified. The position is to be filled as soon as possible.About usEIT Health is one of Europe’s largest and most dynamic health innovation communities, dedicated to improving the lives of citizens and patients and strengthening healthcare systems across the continent.Our mission is simple: to drive healthcare innovation and create positive societal impact across Europe. In a landscape marked by an ageing population, rising chronic disease, workforce shortages, and increasing pressure on healthcare budgets, our community serves as a catalyst, enabling creative thinking, cross-border collaboration, and evidence-based solutions that deliver real-world impact.As a Knowledge and Innovation Community (KIC) of the European Institute of Innovation and Technology (EIT), our pan-European network brings together over 80 members, exceptional in the worlds of business, education, research and health service delivery, alongside thousands of start-ups, entrepreneurs and healthcare professionals. By combining their collective expertise we help new solutions reach the people and services that need them most.For more information please visit our website: www.eithealth.eu

kiutraDo you want to shape the future as part of a diverse, international team in a fast-growing, deep-tech company? Then read on! At kiutra, we contribute to the development and application of quantum technologies by offering innovative and sustainable cooling solutions based on our unique magnetic cooling technology.To strengthen our team, we're looking for a Chief of Staff (f/m/d) who's ready to work closely with our Managing Director. You dig into topics, get the right people talking, and and stay on top of open items. In this role you bring solid know-how in corporate law, compliance, financing, and accounting to the materials, proposals, and advisor conversations you help shape. You run with things independently and need little guidance.Responsibilities• You prepare decisions for the Managing Director, working through the facts, laying out options, and producing materials and resolution proposals.• You support processes owned by functional departments or external advisors, preparing the Managing Director's input, consolidating information, and organizing alignment.• You coordinate participants, deadlines, and work status across departments, advisors, and countries.• You follow up on open items and deadlines, flagging early when topics stall or drift apart.• You take care of documentation and record keeping minutes, resolutions, deadline overviews, and tracking of commitments made.• You independently handle clearly defined work packages on behalf of the Managing Director, working with a high degree of autonomy.Requirements• You hold a completed university degree in law, business, natural sciences, or comparable; a legal background is an advantage given the governance topics involved.• You bring 3 to 6 years in management consulting, investment banking, a commercial law firm, audit, or a comparable role in a growing technology company.• You have hands-on experience handling commercial, corporate law, or regulatory matters.• You solve problems in a structured and analytical way.• You coordinate and keep track across several topics, including reliable follow-up on open items until completion.• You're confident with numbers: budget, forecast, fundamentals of financial accounting, and you're willing to get to grips with corporate law and tax questions.• You have full professional proficiency in both German and English (written and spoken).• You prepare complex matters precisely and concisely for the respective audience.• You handle confidential shareholder, compensation, and transaction information with the utmost discretion and integrity.• You stay calm and adaptable when priorities shift or things are unclear.• You're ready to align your pace with the Managing Director's including occasional travel as needed.• You're interested in deep tech and hardware; prior technical knowledge is not required.Benefits• You will enjoy flexibility with options for remote work and flexible working hours.• You will experience an open-minded, appreciative startup atmosphere with flat hierarchies and an open-door policy.• You will work with a great team in a fast-growing deep-tech company.• You can expect regular performance reviews and long-term job prospects.• You can look forward to 30 vacation days per year.• You will have the chance to participate in valuable employee surveys.• You will work in a comfortable, bright and modern office with ergonomic equipment in compliance with health requirements.• You can benefit from “The Coolest Connection”, our employee referral program.• You will have the opportunity to get to know your team members better at our teambuilding events, Christmas parties, and other group events.• You will have free cold and hot drinks, snacks, and fruit at your disposal.• You can benefit from our company's pension plan, our bicycle leasing program (Jobrad), and contribution for the Deutschland-Ticket Jobticket.Interested? Then send us your application now! To find out more about us, please visit https://kiutra.com/
